mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important aspect of management."
Leadership is an important aspect of management.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an instrument of planning and control in the school system because it specifies the financial procedures through which the goals and objectives of the school system can be achieved."
School budget is an instrument of planning and control in the school system because it specifies the financial procedures through which the goals and objectives of the school system can be achieved.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the direct opposite of discipline i.e. lack of discipline."
Indiscipline is the direct opposite of discipline i.e. lack of discipline.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important aspect of school administration."
Maintenance of school plant is an important aspect of school administration.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the laws created by statute or acts of parliaments or the legislature arm of government."
Statutory laws are the laws created by statute or acts of parliaments or the legislature arm of government.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an industry that also makes use of human, material and financial resources like the production industry."
Education is an industry that also makes use of human, material and financial resources like the production industry.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a two-way interaction that exists between the school and the community."
School - community relationship is a two-way interaction that exists between the school and the community.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only convincing evidence that the teacher has given adequate thought and consideration to what he/she is teaching."
A lesson note is the only convincing evidence that the teacher has given adequate thought and consideration to what he/she is teaching.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a precious resource in the school; it must be managed well along with other resources to achieve the school goals."
Time is a precious resource in the school; it must be managed well along with other resources to achieve the school goals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the one saddled with the responsibility of making laws."
Legislative arm of government is the one saddled with the responsibility of making laws.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the detailed and meticulous account of any phenomenon."
A record is the detailed and meticulous account of any phenomenon.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the education which each community handed over to the succeeding generations; this is different from the western education or the formal education."
Traditional education in Nigerian is the education which each community handed over to the succeeding generations; this is different from the western education or the formal education.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the maintenance carried out after the breakdowns of the school plant which will require heavy monetary outlay."
Breakdown maintenance is the maintenance carried out after the breakdowns of the school plant which will require heavy monetary outlay.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the manner and approach of providing direction, implementing plans, and motivating people."
Leadership styles are the manner and approach of providing direction, implementing plans, and motivating people.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a perishable commodity; hence human beings have to rely on written document to store ideas and impressions."
Information is a perishable commodity; hence human beings have to rely on written document to store ideas and impressions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ability to mobilize human and material resources towards achievement of organizational goals."
Administration is the ability to mobilize human and material resources towards achievement of organizational goals.
